parameters.query:
WITH target AS (
    SELECT
        d.id,
        d.airtable_dialog_id,
        d.status,
        d.waiting_for,
        d.next_action_at,
        d.metadata
    FROM agent_v3.dialogs d
    WHERE d.airtable_dialog_id = '{{ $json.airtable_dialog_id }}'
    LIMIT 1
),
sync_dialog AS (
    UPDATE agent_v3.dialogs d
    SET
        metadata =
            COALESCE(d.metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'task_status', '{{ $json.task_status }}',
                'task_state_synced_at', NOW(),
                'airtable_task_id', '{{ $json.airtable_task_id }}'
            ),

        status = CASE
            WHEN '{{ $json.task_status }}' = 'Done'
                 AND d.status IN ('new','scheduled','active','waiting_user','waiting_owner')
                THEN 'done'
            ELSE d.status
        END,

        waiting_for = CASE
            WHEN '{{ $json.task_status }}' = 'Done'
                THEN NULL
            ELSE d.waiting_for
        END,

        next_action_at = CASE
            WHEN '{{ $json.task_status }}' IN ('Paused','Done')
                THEN NULL
            ELSE d.next_action_at
        END,

        updated_at = NOW()

    WHERE d.id IN (SELECT id FROM target)

    RETURNING
        d.id,
        d.airtable_dialog_id,
        d.status,
        d.metadata ->> 'task_status' AS task_status
),
cancel_events AS (
    UPDATE agent_v3.events e
    SET
        status = 'cancelled',
        locked_at = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE e.dialog_id IN (SELECT id FROM target)
      AND '{{ $json.task_status }}' IN ('Paused','Done')
      AND e.status IN ('pending','processing')
    RETURNING e.id
)
SELECT
    '{{ $json.airtable_task_id }}' AS airtable_task_id,
    '{{ $json.task_status }}' AS airtable_task_status,
    '{{ $json.airtable_dialog_id }}' AS airtable_dialog_id,
    COALESCE((SELECT id FROM sync_dialog), NULL) AS postgres_dialog_id,
    COALESCE((SELECT status FROM sync_dialog), 'not_found') AS postgres_dialog_status,
    COALESCE((SELECT task_status FROM sync_dialog), '{{ $json.task_status }}') AS postgres_task_status,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cancel_events) AS cancelled_events;

SELECT
    COALESCE(d.telegram_chat_id, d.telegram_user_id) AS telegram_route_id,
    COUNT(*) AS matching_dialogs,
    jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
            'dialog_id', d.id,
            'airtable_dialog_id', d.airtable_dialog_id,
            'status', d.status,
            'task_status', d.metadata ->> 'task_status'
        )
        ORDER BY d.id
    ) AS dialogs
FROM agent_v3.dialogs d
WHERE d.status IN ('scheduled','active','waiting_user','waiting_owner')
  AND COALESCE(d.metadata ->> 'task_status', 'Active') = 'Active'
  AND COALESCE(d.telegram_chat_id, d.telegram_user_id) IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(d.telegram_chat_id, d.telegram_user_id)
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;
